evidence.observation: 2.973 Torr, in line with the ~3.0 Torr seen through the ramp (noise about ±0.02)
Climbed steadily to 3.228 Torr over 6 min of growth (3.087, 3.13, 3.228), far beyond the noise
Flow steady at about 100 sccm, so extra inflow from the gas supply is unlikely
Temperature holds at 750 °C; heater power has settled around 44%, so no thermal fault is evident
Sensor not installed, so an air leak can't be checked directly

args.missing_evidence: A leak-up (rate-of-rise) test with the pump isolated, or checks of the exhaust/pump valve and throttle conductance. Either would show whether this is a seal leak or an exhaust blockage. An exhaust O2 reading would also discriminate, but that sensor is not installed.
